name: partial-designs-round-2
rule: One sheet per guide, in order. A sheet is done when research/mix-sheets/<guideId>.json passes npm run mixes -- check. If the context has no usable mix data, set skip to a one-line reason instead of forcing a sheet. Entries: every guide whose mix status is partial-source-design, not already sheeted, skipped in the pilot queue, or covered by the knowledge pilot/catalog. The finished pilot queue is archived as _QUEUE-fly-ash-slag-pilot.json.
